tours.name: Add an Extra Input to a Single Payslip

name_i18n.en_US: Add an Extra Input to a Single Payslip

tours.description: Learn how to add a one-off amount, such as a bonus or an allowance, to one employee's payslip as an extra input and recompute the payslip so the amount is included.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to add a one-off amount, such as a bonus or an allowance, to one employee's payslip as an extra input and recompute the payslip so the amount is included.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: One-off amounts for a single employee are added directly on that employee's payslip in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: One-off amounts for a single employee are added directly on that employee's payslip in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: The Payslips menu lists the payslips of all employees and the batches they belong to.

description_i18n.en_US: The Payslips menu lists the payslips of all employees and the batches they belong to.

steps.title: All Payslips
steps.description: This list shows every payslip with the employee, period and net amount.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every payslip with the employee, period and net amount.

steps.title: Open a batch
steps.content: Click a batch name to show its payslips.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a batch name to show its payslips.

steps.description: Payslips are grouped by batch. Expand the batch that contains the payslip you want to change.

description_i18n.en_US: Payslips are grouped by batch. Expand the batch that contains the payslip you want to change.

steps.title: Open the payslip
steps.content: Click the payslip to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the payslip to open it.

steps.description: Extra inputs can only be added while the payslip is not yet done, so open a draft or waiting payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: Extra inputs can only be added while the payslip is not yet done, so open a draft or waiting payslip.

steps.title: Worked days and inputs
steps.content: Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

steps.description: This tab has two parts: the worked days and, below them, the Other Inputs table where one-off amounts are added.

description_i18n.en_US: This tab has two parts: the worked days and, below them, the Other Inputs table where one-off amounts are added.

steps.title: Add a line
steps.content: Click Add a line in the Other Inputs table.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Add a line in the Other Inputs table.

steps.description: A new line opens in the table so you can describe the extra amount.

description_i18n.en_US: A new line opens in the table so you can describe the extra amount.

steps.title: Input type
steps.content: Click here to open the list of input types.

content_i18n.en_US: Click here to open the list of input types.

steps.description: The input type tells payroll what the amount is, for example a bonus or an allowance. Each type is linked to a salary rule that adds it to the payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: The input type tells payroll what the amount is, for example a bonus or an allowance. Each type is linked to a salary rule that adds it to the payslip.

steps.title: Choose the type
steps.content: Click the input type that matches the amount. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the input type that matches the amount. If you do not see it in the short list, click Search More... and pick it in the window that opens.

steps.description: Choose the type that matches the payment. Only the types allowed for this employee's salary structure are offered.

description_i18n.en_US: Choose the type that matches the payment. Only the types allowed for this employee's salary structure are offered.

steps.title: Amount
steps.content: Type the amount, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the amount, then press Tab.

steps.description: Enter the amount to add for this payslip. It applies to this payslip only and is not repeated on later months.

description_i18n.en_US: Enter the amount to add for this payslip. It applies to this payslip only and is not repeated on later months.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the change.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the change.

steps.description: Save the payslip so the new input is stored. The pay does not change until the payslip is recomputed.

description_i18n.en_US: Save the payslip so the new input is stored. The pay does not change until the payslip is recomputed.

steps.title: Compute Sheet
steps.content: Click Compute Sheet to include the new amount.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Compute Sheet to include the new amount.

steps.description: Compute Sheet recalculates the payslip. The extra amount now appears as a line on the Salary Computation tab and changes the net salary.

description_i18n.en_US: Compute Sheet recalculates the payslip. The extra amount now appears as a line on the Salary Computation tab and changes the net salary.
